source.caution:
[프로폴리스추출물]
(1) 프로폴리스에 알레르기를 나타내는 사람은 섭취에 주의
(2) 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것 
[비타민C]
(1) 과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의할 것
(2) 신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담할 것
(3) 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
[비타민D]
(1) 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
(2) 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
[비타민K]
(1) 항응고제 등 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
(2) 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것

drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodManganese 3mgVitamin C 50mgVitamin D 17.5μgVitamin K 70μgSelenium 30μgZinc 6mgCalcium 210mgPropolis 20mgOnce a day

Bee propolis Multivitamin MineralsManganese · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Selenium · Zinc · Calcium · Propolis

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 3mg of Manganese, 50mg of Vitamin C, 17.5μg of Vitamin D, 70μg of Vitamin K, 30μg of Selenium, 6mg of Zinc, 210mg of Calcium, 20mg of Propolis as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 3mg Manganese, 50mg Vitamin C, 17.5μg Vitamin D, 70μg Vitamin K, 30μg Selenium, 6mg Zinc, 210mg Calcium, 20mg Propolis
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Propolis
    • May help with antioxidant activity

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Manganese labelled (3mg / 1500mg), 90~150%
Vitamin C labelled (50mg / 1500mg), 90~150%
Vitamin D labelled (17.5μg / 1500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin K labelled (70μg / 1500mg), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (30μg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (6mg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (210mg / 1500mg), 90~150%
Propolis labelled (20mg / 1500mg), 90~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 주황색의 장방형 제피정제
Shelf life 제조일로부터 36개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Manganese · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Selenium · Zinc · Calcium · Propolis together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
